game.title: Los Angeles Chargers at Seattle Seahawks

lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Seattle Seahawks -9.8 with a fair total of 40.8, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Seattle Seahawks pass defence, which sits −0.291 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
